non_negotiables: <an invariant that outranks every story; a story that violates it is rejected, not queued>

allow: <exact service/db identity that may be mutated, e.g. shiori-slice-01>
deny: <identity that must never be mutated, e.g. shiori-spike>

stories.title: <short imperative>
stories.user_story: As a <role>, I want <capability>, so that <outcome>
stories.from_ask: <the human's request, VERBATIM — required in lightweight mode>
stories.why_now: <one line: sequencing rationale; walking skeleton first>

commands: <exact, re-runnable, passes from a clean checkout>
verification.done_when: <one sentence a reviewer confirms WITHOUT reading the diff>

read_first: <ordered, specific paths a fresh squad reads before starting>

squad.rationale: <why these roles for this story — execution spawns only these>
